title: AgentOrchestratorReviewVerdict
description: Structured review output from the review worker under Review Convergence Protocol. Exact PASS is the only merge-authorizing control verdict and may carry deferred non-blocking notes. PASS_WITH_NOTES remains schema-valid for recording only and does not authorize merge.

verdict.description: PASS: no open blockers; only authorizing control verdict (deferred notes allowed). PASS_WITH_NOTES: schema-valid non-authorizing record only. BLOCKED: one or more open blockers. FAIL: critical defects or task non-satisfaction.

reviewed_head_sha.description: The exact PR head SHA that was reviewed

blockers.description: Open hard-contract issues that block the current head (correctness, safety, authority, evidence, rollback, scope). Must be empty for PASS. Must be non-empty for BLOCKED.

major_notes.description: Deferred non-blocking major notes; allowed on PASS; must not force a new head

minor_notes.description: Deferred non-blocking minor notes; allowed on PASS; must not force a new head

ci_green.description: Whether all required CI jobs were green at time of review

security_ok.description: Whether the diff passes security review

rollback_ok.description: Whether the change has a clear rollback path
